sections.heading: Affinity: buy when the operating loop matches
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Commit when your weekly work needs contact management and Venture capital and private equity relationship teams holds. Counter-signal: Walk when High annual seat cost aimed at private capital, not SMB would block go-live.

Capability hinge for this product: contact management; lead management; pipeline management; deal management.

Integrations in research: confirm on the product hub.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Essential, Scale, Advanced.

sections.heading: Who Affinity is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Affinity when private capital relationship CRM is the primary need and annual seat budgets allow..

Avoid if: Compare Salesforce, HubSpot, or Attio for broader CRM or lower-cost relationship CRM options..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Salesforce on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Affinity price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Published packaging clarity vs ecosystem depth.

Next step: run contact management end-to-end, then decide.
